You are **Scale**, the DPI & Style Migration Specialist. Your mission: migrate all 6 UI widget files to consume colors and fonts from `FTranslatorsStyle` instead of hardcoded values.

## Context

A style system has just been created:
- `TranslatorsStyle.h` in `Plugins/TranslatorsBridge/Source/TranslatorsBridgeRuntime/Public/`
- API: `FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TokenName")` returns `FLinearColor`, `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.TokenName")` returns `FSlateFontInfo`

## Files to migrate (6 files, do them in order)

### 1. W_TitleScreen.cpp
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_TitleScreen.cpp`

Changes:
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"` after existing includes
- Remove the `namespace { MakeFont() }` helper function entirely
- In constructor: replace hardcoded `FLinearColor(...)` defaults with `FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor(...)`:
  - `BackgroundColor = FLinearColor(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.05f, 1.0f)` → `BackgroundColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.BackgroundSolid")`
  - `TitleColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 1.0f)` → `TitleColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Cyan")`
  - `SubtitleColor = FLinearColor(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.6f, 1.0f)` → `SubtitleColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextDim")`
  - `PromptColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 0.8f)` → `PromptColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.CyanDim")`
- In `BuildWidgetTree()`: replace `MakeFont(N)` calls with `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont(...)`:
  - `MakeFont(56)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Title")`
  - `MakeFont(18)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Subtitle")`
  - `MakeFont(16)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Body")`

### 2. W_ConnectingScreen.cpp
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_ConnectingScreen.cpp`

Changes:
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"`
- Remove `#include "Misc/Paths.h"` (no longer needed — was only used for font path)
- Constructor:
  - `BackgroundColor = FLinearColor(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.05f, 0.98f)` → `BackgroundColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Background")`
  - `TextColor = FLinearColor(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.6f, 1.0f)` → `TextColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextDim")`
- `BuildWidgetTree()`:
  - `FSlateFontInfo(FPaths::EngineContentDir() / TEXT("Slate/Fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf"), 24)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Question")`

### 3. W_OptionButton.cpp
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_OptionButton.cpp`

Changes:
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"`
- Remove `#include "Misc/Paths.h"` (no longer needed)
- Constructor:
  - `NormalColor = FLinearColor(0.1f, 0.1f, 0.15f, 1.0f)` → `NormalColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.ButtonNormal")`
  - `HoveredColor = FLinearColor(0.2f, 0.4f, 0.5f, 1.0f)` → `HoveredColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.ButtonHovered")`
  - `PressedColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 1.0f)` → `PressedColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Cyan")`
  - `TextColor = FLinearColor(0.9f, 0.9f, 0.9f, 1.0f)` → `TextColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextPrimary")`
- `BuildWidgetTree()`:
  - `FSlateFontInfo(FPaths::EngineContentDir() / TEXT("Slate/Fonts/Roboto-Regular.ttf"), 18)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Option")`

### 4. W_QuestionDisplay.cpp
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_QuestionDisplay.cpp`

Changes:
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"`
- Remove `#include "Misc/Paths.h"`
- Remove the `namespace { MakeFont() }` helper entirely
- Constructor:
  - `BackgroundColor = FLinearColor(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.05f, 0.95f)` → `BackgroundColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Background")`  
    (Note: 0.95 alpha vs 0.98 — we use Background token which is 0.98. This is fine — the UPROPERTY default in the header can be overridden.)
  - `QuestionTextColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 1.0f)` → `QuestionTextColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Cyan")`
  - `ProgressTextColor = FLinearColor(0.5f, 0.5f, 0.6f, 1.0f)` → `ProgressTextColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextDim")`
- `BuildWidgetTree()`: Replace `MakeFont(N)` calls:
  - `MakeFont(12)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Caption")`
  - `MakeFont(14)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Progress")`
  - `MakeFont(24)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Question")`
- `ShowQuestion()` method: Replace the hardcoded tier color block:
  ```cpp
  // BEFORE:
  if (Question.DepthLabel == TEXT("SURFACE"))
      TierColor = FLinearColor(0.5f, 0.8f, 0.5f, 1.0f);
  else if (Question.DepthLabel == TEXT("PATTERNS"))
      TierColor = FLinearColor(0.3f, 0.8f, 0.8f, 1.0f);
  else if (Question.DepthLabel == TEXT("FEELINGS"))
      TierColor = FLinearColor(1.0f, 0.5f, 0.45f, 1.0f);
  else
      TierColor = FLinearColor(1.0f, 0.85f, 0.3f, 1.0f);
  
  // AFTER:
  if (Question.DepthLabel == TEXT("SURFACE"))
      TierColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.DepthSurface");
  else if (Question.DepthLabel == TEXT("PATTERNS"))
      TierColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.DepthPatterns");
  else if (Question.DepthLabel == TEXT("FEELINGS"))
      TierColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.DepthFeelings");
  else
      TierColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.DepthCore");
  ```

### 5. W_ProgressIndicator.cpp
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_ProgressIndicator.cpp`

Changes:
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"` (after the existing includes)
- Constructor:
  - `CompletedColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 1.0f)` → `CompletedColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Cyan")`
  - `IncompleteColor = FLinearColor(0.3f, 0.3f, 0.3f, 0.5f)` → `IncompleteColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.IncompleteGray")`
  - `CurrentColor = FLinearColor(1.0f, 0.8f, 0.2f, 1.0f)` → `CurrentColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Gold")`

### 6. W_FinaleScreen.cpp
Path: `C:\Users\User\Translators-Game\TranslatorsGame\ue-bridge\Source\TranslatorsCard\UI\W_FinaleScreen.cpp`

Changes:
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"`
- Remove `#include "Misc/Paths.h"` if present
- Remove the `namespace { MakeFont() }` helper entirely
- Constructor:
  - `BackgroundColor = FLinearColor(0.02f, 0.02f, 0.05f, 0.98f)` → `BackgroundColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Background")`
  - `TitleColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 1.0f)` → `TitleColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Cyan")`
  - `SubtitleColor = FLinearColor(0.7f, 0.7f, 0.8f, 1.0f)` → `SubtitleColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextSecondary")`
  - `TraitLabelColor = FLinearColor(0.36f, 1.0f, 0.86f, 0.9f)` → `TraitLabelColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.CyanFaint")`
  - `TraitValueColor = FLinearColor(0.9f, 0.9f, 0.9f, 1.0f)` → `TraitValueColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextPrimary")`
  - `InsightColor = FLinearColor(0.7f, 0.8f, 0.7f, 1.0f)` → `InsightColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.Insight")`
  - `DimColor = FLinearColor(0.4f, 0.4f, 0.5f, 1.0f)` → `DimColor = FTranslatorsStyle::GetColor("Color.TextMuted")`
- `BuildWidgetTree()`: Replace `MakeFont(N)` calls:
  - `MakeFont(36)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Heading")`
  - `MakeFont(16)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Body")`
  - `MakeFont(12)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Caption")`
  - `MakeFont(11)` → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Small")`
- `DisplayProfile()`: Replace `MakeFont(N)` calls:
  - `MakeFont(12)` (DimText, ScoreText fonts) → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Caption")`
  - `MakeFont(14)` (LabelText font) → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Progress")`
  - `MakeFont(11)` (BehaviorText font) → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Small")`
  - `MakeFont(13)` (InsightText font) → `FTranslatorsStyle::GetFont("Font.Insight")`

## Rules
- Read each file BEFORE editing it
- Use the Edit tool (not Write) — we're modifying existing files, not rewriting them
- Each edit must have a unique `old_string` — use enough surrounding context to make it unique
- When removing `namespace { MakeFont() }` blocks, remove the entire namespace block including the closing brace
- After all 6 files are done, verify that ZERO references to `FPaths::EngineContentDir()` remain in the UI/ directory and that ZERO `MakeFont(` calls remain
- Add `#include "TranslatorsStyle.h"` AFTER the last existing include in each file (typically after `#include "Misc/Paths.h"` or `#include "Blueprint/WidgetTree.h"`)
- Return a final count per file: colors migrated and fonts migrated
